divergences.description: Spec 1.6's Code Map says the expiry overlay's confirm action should call `context.go('/reauth')`. The code calls `widget.router.go(AppRoutePaths.reauth)` instead and gets a context below the Navigator through an explicit shared `navigatorKey`. The reason is that the `MaterialApp.router` builder sits above the `InheritedGoRouter`, so `context.go` would not find a router there. The spec's Suggested Review Order records this change ('confirm navigates via `router.go`, never `context.go`').

Several planned files outside lib/ and test/ do not appear in the diff, although their tasks are marked done. Missing: `pubspec.yaml`, `.fvmrc`, `.env.example` and the `AGENTS.md` edit (Story 1.1); the bundled font assets and `pubspec.yaml`'s `fonts:` section (Story 1.2); the portrait-only lock in `ios/Runner/Info.plist` (Story 1.6). The code still relies on them: `DesignTokens` uses the 'Fraunces', 'Karla' and 'IBMPlexMono' font families, the app imports `go_router`, and `main.dart` says the portrait lock lives in `Info.plist`.
